description_target.ambiguity_notes: Sparse noise can accidentally preserve a smaller period. Reject generated examples where another plausible period ties the edit score and yields a different reconstruction.
negative_constraints: Require at least two repeats along both active axes.
Reject tiles that themselves have a smaller row or column period unless the smaller-period reconstruction is identical.
Keep noise sparse enough that every periodic slot has a clear majority.
Do not let inactive background cells compete with active periodic cells.
solution_steps: Enumerate plausible row offsets and row/column periods.
For each candidate, collect all cells that share each periodic slot and choose the mode value.
Score each candidate by the number of cells that differ from the input reconstruction.
Return the grid generated by the lowest-edit candidate.
description_target.target_text: Reconstruct a noisy periodic grid by trying plausible row offsets and tile periods, majority-voting each periodic slot, and choosing the reconstruction with the fewest input edits.
